# Psalm 107 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 107:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Let-say the-redeemed-of YHWH, whom he-has-redeemed from-hand-of the-adversary,
- **LOGOS:** Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from trouble
- **PNEUMA:** Let everyone the LORD has rescued say so — those he freed from the enemy's grip,

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** And-from-the-lands he-has-gathered-them, from-east and-from-west, from-north and-from-south.
- **LOGOS:** and gathered in from the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
- **PNEUMA:** those he gathered from distant lands, from east and west, from north and south.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 107:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** They-wandered in-the-wilderness in-a-wasteland way; a-city-of habitation not they-found.
- **LOGOS:** Some wandered in desert wastes, finding no way to a city to dwell in;
- **PNEUMA:** Some wandered through the desert with no path, unable to find a town to live in.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 107:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-they-cried to-YHWH in-their-distress; from-their-troubles he-delivered-them.
- **LOGOS:** Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.
- **PNEUMA:** Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and he rescued them from their misery.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** Let-them-give-thanks to-YHWH for-his-steadfast-love, and-his-wonders to-sons-of man.
- **LOGOS:** Let them thank the LORD for his steadfast love, for his wondrous works to the children of man!
- **PNEUMA:** Let them thank the LORD for his faithful love and for his amazing works for humanity!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 107:11 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For they-rebelled-against words-of God, and-counsel-of the-Most-High they-spurned.
- **LOGOS:** for they had rebelled against the words of God, and spurned the counsel of the Most High.
- **PNEUMA:** because they had defied God's commands and rejected the counsel of the Most High.
